tips.text: Drop your clan to Ghost tier before researching; research costs rise threefold or more with each tier above it.
Build the weapon during the off weeks so it is finished when you chase its Incarnon adapter.
Expect an afternoon of foundry waits for the gun; the long wait is the nine-week Circuit rotation for its Incarnon adapter.
Players call it one of the best secondaries in the game, which is why the wait for its adapter is the loudest complaint.
